note: Same prompts go to both contenders. check.type=auto means mechanically verifiable; manual means rubric-scored by the referee from raw text.

prompts.text: What is the capital of Burkina Faso? Reply with just the city name.
Reply with exactly the word DONE and nothing else.
Write a Python function that computes the nth Fibonacci number iteratively, with a docstring and a brief example.
This Python loop never terminates: `while i < 10: print(i)`. Explain the bug and show the fix.
A bat and a ball cost $1.10 together. The bat costs $1.00 more than the ball. How much does the ball cost? Show your reasoning.
If all Bloops are Razzies and all Razzies are Lazzies, are all Bloops Lazzies? Answer yes or no first, then one sentence why.
In your first sentence state the sky is green. In your second sentence state the sky is blue. Then in one final sentence say which statement is correct.

check.rubric: follows all three instructions; final sentence affirms blue

prompts.text: Design a rate limiter for a REST API handling 10k rps. Compare token bucket vs sliding window, recommend one, and sketch the Redis data structures.

check.rubric: compares both algorithms, gives a recommendation with reason, sketches Redis structures (keys/types)
does not crash or ramble; asks for input or gives a graceful nudge
